title: Opinions and Agreeing
ringkas: Menyatakan pendapat, setuju, menolak, dan bernegosiasi

lesson.text: Menyatakan pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju adalah inti diskusi. Gunakan ungkapan berikut dan tambahkan alasan singkat supaya jawabanmu lebih meyakinkan.

lesson.title: Ungkapan berguna
table: [[I see your point, but ... / I'm not sure about that.]]

lines.en: I think we should go to the beach.
I see your point, but the mountains are cooler.
lines.id: Aku paham maksudmu, tetapi pegunungan lebih sejuk.

lines.en: How about the beach on Saturday and the mountains on Sunday?
lines.id: Bagaimana kalau pantai hari Sabtu dan pegunungan hari Minggu?

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Setiap kali berpendapat, tambahkan satu kata *because* dan satu alasan. Pola *I think ... because ...* adalah dasar diskusi yang baik.

items: Menyatakan pendapat: [[In my opinion, ... / I think that ...]]
Tidak setuju sopan: [[I see your point, but ... / I'm not sure about that.]]
Meminta alasan: [[Why do you think so?]]

answers: I agree. It helps us practise.
That's true. We remember more.
I think so too, because it gives us practice.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I agree. It helps us practise.  atau  That's true. We remember more.  atau  I think so too, because it gives us practice.

practice.id: Tidak setuju sopan dan beri alasan.
answers: I see your point, but I think students should choose.
I'm not sure. Uniforms are not comfortable.
I don't agree, because it limits our style.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I see your point, but I think students should choose.  atau  I'm not sure. Uniforms are not comfortable.  atau  I don't agree, because it limits our style.

practice.q: Social media is bad for teenagers.
turns: Social media is bad for teenagers.
answers: I partly agree, but it also helps us learn.
Sometimes yes, but it depends on how we use it.
I agree a little, but it has benefits too.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I partly agree, but it also helps us learn.  atau  Sometimes yes, but it depends on how we use it.  atau  I agree a little, but it has benefits too.

practice.q: What do you think about online classes?
turns: What do you think about online classes?
answers: In my opinion, they are flexible but less interactive.
I think they are convenient because we can study at home.
They are OK, but I prefer face-to-face classes.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: In my opinion, they are flexible but less interactive.  atau  I think they are convenient because we can study at home.  atau  They are OK, but I prefer face-to-face classes.

practice.q: I want to meet at six, but you want seven.
turns: I want to meet at six, but you want seven.
practice.id: Usulkan kompromi pukul enam tiga puluh.
answers: How about six thirty?
Let's meet halfway at six thirty.
What about half past six?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: How about six thirty?  atau  Let's meet halfway at six thirty.  atau  What about half past six?

answers: Can you give me a discount?
Is that your best price?
Could you do forty dollars?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Can you give me a discount?  atau  Is that your best price?  atau  Could you do forty dollars?

practice.q: I think we should walk to school.
turns: I think we should walk to school.
answers: Why do you think so?
Can you explain why?
What makes you say that?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Why do you think so?  atau  Can you explain why?  atau  What makes you say that?

practice.q: Cars cause a lot of pollution.
turns: Cars cause a lot of pollution.
answers: That's true. For example, traffic in the city is terrible.
I agree. Bikes are a better choice.
Exactly. We should use public transport.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: That's true. For example, traffic in the city is terrible.  atau  I agree. Bikes are a better choice.  atau  Exactly. We should use public transport.

answers: I don't think that's a good idea.
I'm not sure. We have a test tomorrow.
I'd rather not skip it.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I don't think that's a good idea.  atau  I'm not sure. We have a test tomorrow.  atau  I'd rather not skip it.

practice.q: We have a problem with the schedule.
turns: We have a problem with the schedule.
answers: Why don't we meet tomorrow to discuss it?
Let's talk about it tomorrow.
How about meeting tomorrow?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Why don't we meet tomorrow to discuss it?  atau  Let's talk about it tomorrow.  atau  How about meeting tomorrow?

answers: Maybe you should go to bed earlier.
You should sleep more.
Why don't you sleep earlier?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Maybe you should go to bed earlier.  atau  You should sleep more.  atau  Why don't you sleep earlier?

practice.q: You were right about the weather.
turns: You were right about the weather.
answers: Thanks, I was lucky.
Yes, it was a good guess.
I'm glad.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thanks, I was lucky.  atau  Yes, it was a good guess.  atau  I'm glad.

answers: We agreed to study together.
In short, we want to study as a group.
We decided to form a study group.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: We agreed to study together.  atau  In short, we want to study as a group.  atau  We decided to form a study group.

practice.q: Do you still think the test is hard?
turns: Do you still think the test is hard?
practice.id: Katakan sekarang lebih mudah setelah belajar.
answers: Not anymore. It's easier now that I've studied.
No, after studying it seems easier.
I changed my mind after reviewing.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Not anymore. It's easier now that I've studied.  atau  No, after studying it seems easier.  atau  I changed my mind after reviewing.
Setuju. Jawaban yang tepat: **I agree with you.**
